input.title: OPEC+ agrees to extend production cuts through Q3
input.summary: OPEC+ ministers agreed on Sunday to extend existing production cuts through the third quarter.
input.body_excerpt: OPEC+ ministers agreed on Sunday to extend existing supply cuts through the third quarter, citing continued demand uncertainty and a desire to defend prices amid softening global growth.

input.title: Tensions rise near Strait of Hormuz after tanker incident
input.summary: A tanker incident near the Strait of Hormuz has raised fears of supply disruption.
input.body_excerpt: A tanker was reportedly intercepted near the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, raising fears of a broader disruption to one of the world's most critical oil shipping chokepoints. Crude futures jumped on the news.

input.title: OPEC monthly report shows output roughly in line with quotas
input.summary: OPEC's routine monthly report showed member output broadly matching agreed quotas.
input.body_excerpt: OPEC's monthly report, published Thursday, showed member states broadly complying with existing production quotas, with only minor deviations. Analysts called the report unremarkable.

input.title: Fed delivers surprise 50bp rate cut, cites labor market weakness
input.summary: The Federal Reserve unexpectedly cut rates by 50 basis points, citing a softening labor market.
input.body_excerpt: The Federal Reserve cut its benchmark rate by 50 basis points on Wednesday, a larger move than the 25bp most economists expected, with Chair Powell citing recent softness in labor market data as the primary driver.

input.title: Fed holds rates, Powell signals no cuts until inflation cools further
input.summary: The Fed held rates steady and Powell struck a hawkish tone on the path ahead.
input.body_excerpt: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate steady on Wednesday, and Chair Powell said in the press conference that the committee sees no near-term cuts until inflation shows more sustained progress toward the 2% target.

input.title: Fed holds rates steady, matching expectations
input.summary: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged, exactly as markets had priced in.
input.body_excerpt: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate unchanged at Wednesday's meeting, a widely expected outcome that markets had almost fully priced in ahead of time. The statement language was largely unchanged from the prior meeting.

input.title: US tightens export restrictions on advanced AI chips to China
input.summary: New US rules further restrict sales of advanced AI chips to Chinese customers.
input.body_excerpt: The US Commerce Department on Monday announced tightened export restrictions on advanced AI chips destined for Chinese customers, closing loopholes used by some manufacturers to route sales through third countries.

input.title: US eases some chip export curbs after industry lobbying
input.summary: Washington loosened certain semiconductor export restrictions following industry pressure.
input.body_excerpt: The Commerce Department said Thursday it would ease some export restrictions on mid-tier AI chips following months of lobbying from US semiconductor manufacturers concerned about losing market share to non-US competitors.

input.title: PBOC cuts reserve requirement ratio in surprise stimulus move
input.summary: China's central bank cut the reserve requirement ratio to boost lending.
input.body_excerpt: The People's Bank of China cut the reserve requirement ratio for major banks by 50 basis points on Friday, a surprise move aimed at freeing up lending capacity as policymakers look to shore up a slowing economy.

input.title: Major Chinese developer misses bond payment as property crisis deepens
input.summary: A large Chinese property developer missed a scheduled bond payment.
input.body_excerpt: A major Chinese property developer missed a scheduled offshore bond payment on Monday, the latest sign that the sector's debt crisis is deepening despite repeated government intervention over the past two years.

input.title: Bank of Thailand cuts policy rate to support growth
input.summary: The BOT cut its policy rate, citing the need to support a sluggish economy.
input.body_excerpt: The Bank of Thailand's Monetary Policy Committee voted to cut the policy rate by 25 basis points on Wednesday, citing sluggish growth and below-target inflation as justification for the easing move.

input.title: Thai coalition government faces no-confidence vote amid coalition rift
input.summary: A widening rift in Thailand's ruling coalition has triggered a no-confidence motion.
input.body_excerpt: Thailand's ruling coalition is facing a no-confidence vote after a junior partner threatened to withdraw over a dispute on fiscal policy, raising fresh questions about political stability heading into a critical budget session.

input.title: Major European bank triggers emergency resolution after liquidity failure
input.summary: Regulators placed a major European bank into emergency resolution overnight.
input.body_excerpt: European regulators placed a major regional bank into emergency resolution overnight after a sudden liquidity shortfall triggered a run on deposits, raising fears of broader contagion across European financial markets.

input.title: Thai state oil major reports refinery outage after OPEC+ output cut ripples through region
input.summary: PTT reported a temporary refinery outage as regional crude allocations tightened following OPEC+'s cut.
input.body_excerpt: PTT reported a temporary outage at one of its refineries on Tuesday, attributing part of the disruption to tighter regional crude allocations following OPEC+'s latest round of supply cuts. Thai energy shares rose on the news.

input.title: 5 stocks every young investor should consider in 2026
input.summary: A listicle recommending five stocks for young investors.
input.body_excerpt: In this article we round up five stocks that financial influencers say every young investor should have on their radar this year, based on a mix of growth potential and brand recognition.

input.title: Mid-cap retailer posts in-line quarterly earnings
input.summary: A mid-cap retailer reported earnings roughly in line with analyst estimates.
input.body_excerpt: A mid-cap apparel retailer reported quarterly earnings per share of $0.42, in line with the $0.41 analysts had expected, with revenue also roughly matching consensus. Shares were little changed in after-hours trading.
